chapter.heading: A Song of Praise to the Sovereign Lord
chapter.v:
The Lord
reigns;Let the earth rejoice;Let the multitude of isles be glad! [Is. 41:1 b Jer. 1:5; Matt. 1:20; Luke 1:35; John]

Clouds and
darkness surround Him;Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne. [Is. 11:4; Hos. 6:5; [Heb. 4:12]; Rev. 1:16; 2:12 $] [Ps. 45:5] [Is. 51:16]

A fire
goes before Him,And burns up His enemies round about. [[Is. 41:8; 42:1; Zech. 3:8] g Is. 44:23; Matt. 12:18; [John 13:31, 32; Eph. 1:6]]

His lightnings
light the world;The earth sees and trembles.

The mountains
melt like wax at the presence of the Lord,At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth. [Matt. 23:37 $; [Rom. 11:25-29]]

The heavens
declare His righteousness,And all the peoples see His glory.

Let all
be put to shame who serve carved images,Who boast of idols.Worship Him, all you gods. [[Ps. 22:6; Is. 53:3 $; Matt. Mark 15:29; Luke 23:35 l [Is. 52:15]]

Zion hears
and is glad,And the daughters of Judah rejoiceBecause of Your judgments, O Lord. [Ps. 69:13; 2 Cor. 6:2 $] [Is. 42:6]

For You,
Lord, are most high above all the earth;You are exalted far above all gods. [Is. 61:1; Zech. 9:12; Luke 4:18 $]

You who
love the Lord, hate evil!He preserves the souls of His saints;He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked. [Ps. 23:2; Is. 40:11;] [Is. 33:16; 48:21; Rev. 7:16 $] [Ps. 121:6]

Light is
sown for the righteous,And gladness for the upright in heart. [Is. 40:4]

Rejoice in
the Lord, you righteous,And give thanks at the remembrance of His holy name. [Is. 43:5,]
